name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Caterpie
flavour_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavour_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Scyther
flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Grovyle
flavour_text: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

name: Budew
flavour_text: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.

name: Combee
flavour_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Cottonee
flavour_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Lilligant
flavour_text: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: Durant
flavour_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Smoliv
flavour_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavour_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavour_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
flavour_text: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: If Charmander is healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigorously and won’t go out even if it gets a bit wet.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

name: Torchic
flavour_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
flavour_text: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Numel
flavour_text: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Victini
flavour_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Fuecoco
flavour_text: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
flavour_text: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
flavour_text: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Magikarp
flavour_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Wailmer
flavour_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavour_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Sobble
flavour_text: It’s a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.

name: Drizzile
flavour_text: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.

name: Inteleon
flavour_text: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn’t looking.

name: Frigibax
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Arctibax
flavour_text: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

name: Baxcalibur
flavour_text: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavour_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Yamper
flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Tadbulb
flavour_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Iron Thorns
flavour_text: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Wynaut
flavour_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Chingling
flavour_text: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Mime Jr.
flavour_text: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

name: Klefki
flavour_text: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

name: Fidough
flavour_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Bramblin
flavour_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavour_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Trapinch
flavour_text: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind of trash, making it a widely used and popular Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk
flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

name: Darkrai
flavour_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Skrelp
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it’s caught in a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far away and become unable to return to its home.

name: Zarude
flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Bombirdier
flavour_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Roaring Moon
flavour_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Metang
flavour_text: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

name: Honedge
flavour_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
flavour_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Vibrava
flavour_text: It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint, it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.

name: Axew
flavour_text: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Fraxure
flavour_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Munchlax
flavour_text: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Lillipup
flavour_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Rookidee
flavour_text: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Bramblin
flavour_text: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

name: Brambleghast
flavour_text: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

name: Gimmighoul
flavour_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Trapinch
flavour_text: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions, such as joy and rage, in the form of waves.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind of trash, making it a widely used and popular Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk
flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.

name: Darkrai
flavour_text: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Skrelp
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a poor swimmer. If it’s caught in a fierce storm, it will sometimes get washed far away and become unable to return to its home.

name: Zarude
flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Bombirdier
flavour_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Roaring Moon
flavour_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Metang
flavour_text: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

name: Honedge
flavour_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade
flavour_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aegislash
flavour_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Vibrava
flavour_text: It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint, it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.

name: Axew
flavour_text: If you see peculiar teeth marks on boulders or trees, it means an Axew is likely living nearby.

name: Fraxure
flavour_text: Fraxure uses its thick tusks to neatly cut prey into two portions—one to eat now and one to save for later.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Munchlax
flavour_text: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Lillipup
flavour_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Rookidee
flavour_text: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents to battle against. Its aggression will not be quelled if it doesn’t win.

name: Baxcalibur
flavour_text: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Fidough
flavour_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.
